pages.text: A $(item)Crafter$() crafts with a redstone pulse, using the recipe you lay out in its grid. Click a slot to lock it.
$(item)Bundles$() carry a stack's worth of mixed items in one slot. Dye them any colour.
$(item)Decorated Pots$() now hold a stack of items: use an item on one to put it in. Smash the pot to get them back. Pots in Trial Chambers come with loot inside.
